summary: Iteration 3 tested end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass — GET /api/warehouses auto-creates a default warehouse for a fresh shop, POST creates extra warehouse, PATCH renames, DELETE blocked on default (400 'لا يمكن حذف المخزن الافتراضي'), delete non-default OK, POST /api/products without warehouse_id auto-assigns default warehouse, POST /api/sales/{id}/return creates a mirror sale with is_return=true, total=-abs(src.total), original_invoice_id set, and stock restored (+qty); second call returns 400 'تمّ إرجاع هذه الفاتورة سابقاً'; calling return on a return returns 400 'لا يمكن إرجاع فاتورة مرتجع'. Frontend UI verified: POS renders new 3-column layout with top action bar (Home/Archive/Cards buttons visible), warehouse name in header + bottom status bar, cart headers (اسم الصنف/الكمية/السعر/المجموع) present, all 8 bottom action buttons visible with correct data-testids (pay-cash-btn/print-last-btn/pay-card-btn/open-returns-btn/whatsapp-btn etc.), returns dialog lists past invoices with إرجاع action, WhatsApp dialog opens after a sale and generates correct wa.me/970591234567?text=... link with shop name + invoice # + items + total, Warehouses page /warehouses supports adding a new warehouse (row appears with 'افتراضي' label on the default), Barcode Labels /barcodes has 3 product checkboxes (shadcn role='checkbox'), JsBarcode svgs render after selection (18 svgs incl. previews), 'توليد باركود للمفقود' and 'طباعة الملصقات' buttons work, Sales page shows 'إرجاع' (data-testid=return-btn-{id}) per non-return row, Products create dialog has Warehouse dropdown (المخزن → -- الافتراضي --), Purchases dialog has data-testid='purchase-warehouse-select' populated with default warehouse.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1058 lines — splitting into modules (warehouses, sales, products, etc.) would help maintainability going forward.
POS.jsx is ~445 lines with multiple embedded dialogs (returns, WhatsApp, receipt). Consider extracting ReturnsDialog and WhatsAppDialog into their own components.

In POS.jsx pay() uses `paid: total` for both cash and card — 'تفاصيل الدفع' (pay-card-btn) currently posts payment_method='card' but does not open a payment-details modal despite the label; button behavior does not match its label.

POS.jsx warehouse filter (line 105) allows products with no warehouse_id to appear regardless of selected warehouse — this is lenient and intentional but could hide multi-warehouse leakage bugs; consider strict filtering once backfill guarantees warehouse_id on every product.

return_sale endpoint recomputes profit with sign flip but reuses src.subtotal/tax/discount unchanged (not negated). Analytics that sum subtotal separately from total may double-count. Only total/profit are negated. Consider negating subtotal/tax/discount too or documenting the semantics.
PATCH /api/warehouses ignores wid mismatch — if wid is not found the request still returns {ok:true} (no 404). Minor UX polish.
BarcodeLabels 'توليد باركود للمفقود' generates random client-side codes then PATCHes each; no dedup check against existing barcodes across shop. Acceptable but noted.
Two Dialog components trigger DialogContent aria-describedby warnings in POS (returns + wa). Add DialogDescription for a11y.

CORS is allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True which browsers will reject; cookies are set with samesite='none' + secure=True. Front works because it uses Authorization header via axios, but this misconfiguration is a latent issue for cookie-based auth.
test_credentials: Super admin admin@pos.com / Admin@1234 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Iteration 3 tests create ephemeral shops with prefix TEST_it3_* and TEST_it3ui2_* — no cleanup performed (safe due to prefix).
seed_data_creation: Test shops (TEST_it3_*, TEST_it3ui*_*) with 3 seed products, one sale, one open shift for UI flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 validated. Run backend tests: python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iteration3.py -v -o addopts=''. Note pytest.ini enables xdist; -o override disables parallel. POS 3-col layout has data-testids: pos-home-btn, pos-archive-btn, pos-cards-btn, pos-refresh-btn, pos-logout-btn, pos-warehouse-select, pos-product-{id}, discount-input, pay-cash-btn, pay-card-btn, print-last-btn, open-returns-btn, whatsapp-btn, undo-btn, receipt-close-btn, print-receipt-btn, return-row-{id}, wa-phone-input, wa-send-btn. Sales page uses return-btn-{id}. Purchases dialog: purchase-warehouse-select. WA send is stubbed by hooking window.open to capture the wa.me URL.
rca of the issue: No functional issues found. Only code review comments noted above.
